_README: Corrections to 3D model placement, applied by apply_models.py --fixes.
One entry per (footprint, model) pair that needs a transform the library
does not carry. Values are ABSOLUTE, not deltas, so the file is the state
and a re-run is a no-op. apply_models.py --audit finds candidates.
footprint: regex matched against the footprint name (library nickname
dropped). model: regex matched against the model file basename. Both
must match, so a model shared with a correctly drawn footprint is left
alone.
rotation / offset: [x, y, z], degrees and mm, written into the footprint
exactly as given.
reason: why, measured. The next person needs to know whether the fix
still applies after a library update.
SIGN OF THE Z ROTATION, measured, not assumed: KiCad's model rotation Z
is the NEGATIVE of the rotation that reaches the 3D scene. A footprint
written with rotation [0,0,90] exports with its local X on world -Y,
which is a -90 rotation. So the value here is minus the rotation the
part visibly needs. Verified by exporting a one-footprint board and
reading the AXIS2_PLACEMENT_3D refDirection out of the STEP.
WHY THESE EXIST: KiCad's stock SOT-23 family models are authored for
KiCad's own footprints, which all put pin 1 at (-1.1375, -0.95) with the
three-pad rows running along Y. The EasyEDA-drawn footprints in these
repos use two other conventions, -BL with the rows along X and -BR with
them along Y but pin 1 in the opposite corner, and neither carries a
compensating rotation. The body then sits across its own pads (-BL) or
end for end (-BR).

fixes.reason: Pads run along X (pad 1 at -0.95, +1.15); the stock model is Y-long. -90 maps stock pad 1 (-1.1375, -0.95) onto this footprint's. Boards: OpenFC-Lite U6/U16 and OpenFC-Lite-Mini, the LMR51635 bucks.
Same axis as the stock model but pin 1 in the opposite corner: this footprint's pad 1 is (+1.35, +0.95), the stock model's is (-1.1375, -0.95). Board: OpenESC-20x20 U13, the LMR54406 buck.
Pads along X, stock model Y-long, same as the SOT-23-6 -BL case. Library only today, no board places it, fixed so the next one to place it is right.
Pin 1 in the opposite corner from the stock model, as the SOT-23-6 -BR. Board: OpenFC-Lite U11, the COS8051SOT OSD amplifier.

Model authored Z -0.50 to 0.00, so the AP1606 sits under the board. 0.5 stands it on the face. Found by --audit, not by eye: OpenFC-Lite Q2 already carried this exact offset by hand and Q1 next to it did not, which is what an absolute catalogue is for. Also drops a 0.010 mm X nudge on those two, below anything that matters. Boards: OpenFC-Lite Q1/Q2, OpenFC-Core Q1.

The model is authored entirely below its own origin (Z -0.870 to +0.001), so the SKY13373 RF switch sinks into the board instead of standing on it. 0.87 puts the package base on the board face. Boards: OpenRX-Gemini U5/U8, OpenRX-Mono U5.
